title: 给生活留点余量，和买股票留安全边际是一回事

quotes.source: 格雷厄姆《聪明的投资者》
quotes.original: Confronted with a like challenge to distill the secret of sound investment into three words, we venture the motto, MARGIN OF SAFETY.

quotes.source: 格雷厄姆《聪明的投资者》
quotes.original: The margin is available for absorbing the effect of miscalculations or worse than average luck.
quotes.note: 这句是从读书笔记里的原文摘录核对的，不是一手书页

title: 为什么赚了的总想卖，亏了的却舍不得卖？

quotes.source: Shefrin & Statman (1985), Journal of Finance 40(3)
quotes.original: a general disposition to sell winners too early and hold losers too long
quotes.note: 正文用了它的命名和四个解释（心理账户、怕后悔、自我控制、税），没引数据

quotes.source: Odean (1998), Journal of Finance 53(5)
quotes.original: has been labeled the disposition effect by Shefrin and Statman (1985)

quotes.source: Odean (1998), Journal of Finance 53(5)
quotes.original: a stock that is up in value is more than 50 percent more likely to be sold from day to day than a stock that is down.
quotes.zh: 按全年算，浮盈的股票某一天被卖掉的可能性比浮亏的高五成多
quotes.note: 全年 PGR 0.148、PLR 0.098；12 月方向相反（税务原因），所以正文写「按全年算」

quotes.source: Odean (1998), Journal of Finance 53(5)
quotes.original: For winners that are sold, the average excess return over the following year is 3.4 percent more than it is for losers that are not sold.
quotes.zh: 卖掉的赚钱股，之后一年的超额收益平均比留着的亏钱股高 3.4 个百分点
quotes.note: 样本：美国一家折扣券商 1987–1993 年随机 1 万个账户

quotes.source: Kahneman & Tversky (1979), Econometrica 47(2)
quotes.original: A salient characteristic of attitudes to changes in welfare is that losses loom larger than gains. The aggravation that one experiences in losing a sum of money appears to be greater than the pleasure associated with gaining the same amount.
quotes.zh: 亏一笔钱的难受，好像比赚同样一笔钱的高兴更大
quotes.note: 「参考点常常是买入价」是文章里自己的延伸，不是论文原话

title: 股价不归我管，那什么归我管？

quotes.source: 爱比克泰德《手册》(Enchiridion)
quotes.original: Some things are in our control and others not. Things in our control are opinion, pursuit, desire, aversion, and, in a word, whatever are our own actions. Things not in our control are body, property, reputation, command, and, in one word, whatever are not our own actions.
quotes.zh: 有些事在我们控制之内，有些不在……（正文为意译）
quotes.note: 与 Higginson 译本（Project Gutenberg #45109）第 I 章交叉核对，含义一致：https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/45109

quotes.source: 爱比克泰德《手册》(Enchiridion)
quotes.original: Men are disturbed, not by things, but by the principles and notions which they form concerning things.
quotes.zh: 让人不安的不是事情本身，而是我们对事情的看法（意译）
quotes.note: Higginson 译本：Men are disturbed not by things, but by the views which they take of things.

title: 市场先生每天报价，你得接吗？

quotes.source: 巴菲特 1987 年致股东信
quotes.original: Without fail, Mr. Market appears daily and names a price at which he will either buy your interest or sell you his.
quotes.zh: 故事梗概：合伙人市场先生每天报价，要么买你的，要么卖给你

quotes.source: 巴菲特 1987 年致股东信
quotes.original: He doesn't mind being ignored. If his quotation is uninteresting to you today, he will be back with a new one tomorrow. Transactions are strictly at your option.
quotes.zh: 他不介意被冷落。今天的报价你没兴趣，明天他会带着新的再来。交不交易，由你说了算。

quotes.source: 巴菲特 1987 年致股东信
quotes.original: Mr. Market is there to serve you, not to guide you. It is his pocketbook, not his wisdom, that you will find useful.
quotes.zh: 市场先生是来给你服务的，不是来给你指路的。对你有用的是他的钱包，不是他的见识。

quotes.source: 巴菲特 1987 年致股东信
quotes.original: Indeed, if you aren't certain that you understand and can value your business far better than Mr. Market, you don't belong in the game.

quotes.source: 巴菲特 1987 年致股东信
quotes.original: He can be hurt by such volatility only if he is forced, by either financial or psychological pressures, to sell at untoward times.

mentions.source: 格雷厄姆《聪明的投资者》
mentions.locator: 第8章 The Investor and Market Fluctuations
mentions.note: 只提到寓言出处，没有直接引用书中原话

title: 还没跌就先慌，慌的到底是什么？

quotes.source: 塞涅卡《致卢基里乌斯书信》(Moral Letters to Lucilius)
quotes.original: There are more things, Lucilius, likely to frighten us than there are to crush us; we suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
quotes.zh: 卢基里乌斯，吓到我们的事，比真正压垮我们的事多；我们在想象中受的苦，比现实中多。

quotes.source: 塞涅卡《致卢基里乌斯书信》(Moral Letters to Lucilius)
quotes.original: We are in the habit of exaggerating, or imagining, or anticipating, sorrow.
quotes.zh: 我们习惯于夸大痛苦、想象痛苦，或者预支痛苦。

quotes.source: 塞涅卡《致卢基里乌斯书信》(Moral Letters to Lucilius)
quotes.original: He suffers more than is necessary, who suffers before it is necessary;
quotes.zh: 在必要之前就受苦的人，受的苦比必要的更多。
quotes.note: 原句分号后还有半句，正文只截到分号

quotes.source: 塞涅卡《致卢基里乌斯书信》(Moral Letters to Lucilius)
quotes.original: Be sure to foresee whatever can be foreseen by planning.
quotes.zh: 凡是能靠计划预见的，务必预见到。

mentions.source: 塞涅卡《致卢基里乌斯书信》(Moral Letters to Lucilius)
mentions.locator: 第13封信标题（Gummere 英译本）
mentions.note: On groundless fears，正文提到英译本标题

title: 最近的行情，为什么总被当成未来？

quotes.source: 霍华德·马克斯备忘录 Hindsight First, Please (2005)
quotes.original: Investors mustn’t dwell excessively on recent experience.
quotes.zh: 投资者不能过分沉湎于最近的经历。
quotes.note: 金句库 HM-04。金句库原文撇号为直撇号，此处按 2026-11-12 重新打开的 PDF 用弯撇号，词一致。

quotes.source: 霍华德·马克斯备忘录 Hindsight First, Please (2005)
quotes.original: Recent trends must not be counted on to continue unabated; that’s one of the main lessons of the long-term history that matters.
quotes.zh: 最近的趋势，不能指望它毫无减弱地一直持续；这是那段真正要紧的长期历史给出的主要教训之一。
quotes.note: 金句库以外，2026-11-12 对着官网 PDF 逐字核对。正文整句引用，未改词。

quotes.source: 霍华德·马克斯备忘录 Getting Lucky (2014)
quotes.original: But even the most rigorously derived view of the future is far from sure to be right.
quotes.zh: 即使是推导得最严谨的未来判断，也远不能保证正确。
quotes.note: 金句库 HM-05。前句转引 Dimson，这句是马克斯自己的话。正文用作更一般的提醒，未写成近因偏差的定义。

mentions.source: 霍华德·马克斯备忘录 Hindsight First, Please (2005)
mentions.locator: 第1页，HM-04 后的三条要点
mentions.note: 正文转述「放到未来 / 带着审视看眼下 / 放在更长的历史里判断」，不是逐字引文。原句：Instead, they must look to the future. / They must consider today’s developments critically. / That assessment must take place in the light of history’s lessons.

mentions.source: 霍华德·马克斯备忘录 Hindsight First, Please (2005)
mentions.original: All too often, investors’ interest in the past is limited to the last few months or perhaps a year or two. They look unskeptically, are dazzled by the high returns they see, and jump aboard for more of the same.
mentions.note: 正文转述，未作直接引文；已于 2026-11-12 核对
